name: Constant Contact
description: Intuitive drag-and-drop newsletter builder, list management, and social media ad integration for store owners.
fullDescription: Constant Contact is an approachable, reliable email and digital marketing tool tailored for small business owners and cross-border startups. It offers intuitive drag-and-drop email design, simple contact list segmenting, and integrated social post scheduling.
features: User-friendly drag-and-drop template editor with responsive mobile layouts
Automated email resend to non-openers with customizable subject lines
Built-in social media ad manager for Facebook, Instagram, and Google
Contact list growth tools including pop-up modals and QR code lead forms
Award-winning telephone and live chat support for onboarding assistance
